colors.theme_mode: Light by default with seamless Dark Mode toggle. B2B agency owners in North America value clean white/slate paper aesthetic during day and sleek charcoal at night.

layout_and_grids.bento_strategy: Mode A Tetris & Swiss Structured Grid. Asymmetrical column distribution: 8-col dominant technical breakdown paired with 4-col stat metrics.
layout_and_grids.spacing: Generous. py-20 lg:py-28 on sections. Gap scales gap-6 to gap-12. Card internal padding p-6 or p-8.
layout_and_grids.nav_bar: Sticky header with z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#0C0E12]/85 border-b border-border. Logo wordmark + symbol, 5 desktop links (Services, Work, Pricing, How It Works, About), Partner CTA button ('Request Rate Card'), Dark/Light switch.

visual_enhancers.brand_symbol: Sinnovation geometric monogram: Interlocking 'S' formed by two precision brackets representing White-Label Invisible Integration (Agency + Delivery Pod).
visual_enhancers.data_display: Precision stat counters with metric tags, deltas (+206%, 9.91% CTR), SLA badges (e.g. '48-hr Turnaround Guarantee', '100% Blind IP Transfer', 'White-labeled Slack / ClickUp').
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle hairline gridlines, 1px technical borders, monospaced coordinate badges, no noisy drop-shadows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React JS with modern hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, etc.). Do NOT use TypeScript syntax since this is a JS project.
Install required Lucide icons or use the pre-installed lucide-react package.
Preserve pure CSS & Tailwind without center-everything anti-pattern. Use Swiss alignment with crisp 1px borders.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for all form submissions and admin status changes.
Ensure the private Admin Inbox is pre-populated with realistic initial inquiries from US and Canadian agencies to demonstrate functionality immediately.
Ensure all 9 service detail pages are fully realized with deep technical specifications, deliverables list, sample turnaround times, and white-label pricing models.
Respect contrast rules: all text must pass WCAG AA standards in both light and dark modes.
